subject: CYCLE-2 FINDING: Library same-path create auto-renames instead of failing
body: Adversarial persistence test: after creating PERSISTENCE_CANARY.json with overwrite=false, a second upload to the identical requested destination also returned success but was stored as PERSISTENCE_CANARY(1).json. Therefore live Library create semantics are duplicate-safe rename, not strict create-if-absent. Artifactory NG must fail closed unless returned actual path exactly equals requested path, then read back and hash the stored bytes before emitting a persistence ACK. Preflight existence checks are useful but not sufficient against races; an atomic CAS/create-if-absent primitive remains unproven. Original file was not overwritten.

service.lastTestRef: files.manage_library duplicate-destination upload returned duplicate-safe renamed path
service.blocker: No atomic create-if-absent/CAS proven for Library backend
